title: Artemis plan
author: Devan Goodwin
desc:
Lower body focused plan, 2 glute focused days with 1 upper day and 1 all over day.
Focus on form over weight.

ex.note: Warm up with barbell first and don’t go so heavy that you can’t keep the squat clean

If you feel it in your quads or hamstrings, drop the weight and focus on form.
Proper form and controlled movement is key.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.

ss.note: I’m sorry.
Just breathe, almost done..

ex.note: Aim for an incline between 5 & 8, speed at a fast walk. Comfortable pace but still pushing yourself.
Keep your abs braced and don’t arch your back.

ss.note: Control and proper form over weight.
Same as front raises, control and proper form over weight.
Braced your abs and don’t swing the weight up.
This is the last super set for upper! It will burn and I’m sorry.

ex.note: Core braced and only move your arms, controlled movement and form is key.
Start off at a steady pace for 5 minutes, then increase the intensity.

Lunges, hip rotations, ankle rotations. 
Get yourself ready for deadlifts.

Warm up with the bar and a lighter weight for 15 reps, get a feel of how your body feels.
FORM OVER WEIGHT.
Keep your core braced and your movements slow, controlled and correct.

Almost done, push through but keep your form correct.
We don’t need to show boat, your health is more important.
Deceptively hard! Start with a lighter weight and increase if you can.
Try to not let your back arch up like a cat, flat back and slow, controlled movements.
Or seated, whichever machine your gym has but keep it controlled.
If you can’t do a full sit up to not the end of the world, we will build up to it.

This is going to be a drop set, it’s not nice, it’s not fun, but this is the last workout of the week!
